what: Walmart is the world's largest retailer, with thousands of stores in the US and other countries, Sam's Club warehouse stores and a fast-growing online business.
customers: Hundreds of millions of shoppers a week, mostly low- and middle-income households, increasingly higher-income ones too.
money: groceries and general merchandise in stores and online
Mexico, Canada, China and Flipkart in India
moat: Enormous buying power that keeps prices low, stores within a few miles of about 90% of Americans, and a very efficient supply chain.
risks: Thin margins sensitive to wages and tariffs
A high valuation relative to growth
